slots.STAT_SUB: Wrist to reading. A real cuff, no clinic queue.
slots.FACT_SUB: Early checks catch what you can't feel.
slots.GIFT_BODY: His numbers on his wrist — and on your phone, wherever you are.

1a.title: 30 sec
1a.caption: No queue, no waiting room, no half day gone. The cuff inflates on your wrist, holds, and gives you your number in about thirty seconds. It is the same method the cuff in the clinic uses — measured, not guessed. leiko.health

1b.title: Only old people get high BP
1b.caption: Plenty of us believe high blood pressure is something that comes later, with grey hair. It can start in your thirties, and it rarely announces itself. Check your numbers now and again, and carry them to your doctor. leiko.health

sources.name: Hypertension prevalence among younger Nigerian adults

1c.title: Check on Papa
1c.caption: Papa will tell you he is fine. He probably is — but fine is easier to believe when you can see the number. He wears it, presses once, and the reading reaches your phone wherever you are. leiko.health
